scene.setting: Thai suburban municipal office, paved public forecourt, local road, parking and low-rise neighborhood; sparse roadside planting
scene.composition: Continuous painted neighborhood extends to the left edge; greeting readability uses a local CSS cream gradient, not a baked-in image fade

motion.playback: MP4 loops with pause, reduced-motion posters and error fallback; both citizen and staff login use their user-approved Grok video clips

symbols.subject: municipal office
symbols.usage: shared identity; sidebar branding; service-house vignette

symbols.subject: staff member and citizen at a service counter
document folder
symbols.usage: drafts; uploads; case history; audit context

accessibility: Every interactive object has a text label. Decorative repeated art is aria-hidden; meaningful standalone art has a concise Thai alternative. Status and permissions are conveyed with text.
provenance: Original panorama generated with built-in image_gen; SVG objects authored for this project. No official crest or reference game characters used.
